description: Fictional Internet aliases inspired by BBS, IRC, warez, phreak, cypherpunk and underground computing cultures. Every term carries a gloss, semantic tags and a plausible period range, so the scorer can explain *why* a handle fits a character rather than just ranking it. The system deliberately favours specificity, wordplay and understatement over generic cyber-warrior branding.
